# omada_switch (Data Source)

Looks up an adopted Omada switch by MAC address or name and returns its inventory, status and physical ports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_switch" "main" {
  mac = "D8-44-89-38-C6-C0"
}

output "switch_model" {
  value = data.omada_switch.main.model
}

output "switch_ports" {
  value = data.omada_switch.main.ports
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `mac` (String) Switch MAC lookup selector and result.
- `name` (String) Switch name lookup selector and result.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.

### Read-Only

- `client_count` (Number) Number of connected clients.
- `compound_model` (String) Controller compound model identifier.
- `firmware_version` (String) Firmware version.
- `hardware_version` (String) Hardware version.
- `ip` (String) Management IP address.
- `model` (String) Hardware model.
- `need_upgrade` (Boolean) Whether a firmware update is available.
- `port_count` (Number) Number of physical ports returned by the controller.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Physical switch ports and their current profile/VLAN configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number.
- `status` (Number) Raw controller status code.
- `status_category` (Number) Status category: 0 disconnected, 1 connected, or 2 pending.
- `uptime_seconds` (Number) Device uptime in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `duplex` (Number) Configured duplex enum.
- `link_speed` (Number) Configured link-speed enum.
- `name` (String) Port display name.
- `native_network_id` (String) Native VLAN network ID.
- `network_tags_setting` (Number) VLAN tag policy.
- `port` (Number) Physical port number.
- `profile_id` (String) Assigned port-profile ID.
